_doc: Copy to edit/edl.json once the footage has been reviewed. Times are seconds. Paths are relative to the repo root. Every value here is a creative decision; tools/render.py executes it exactly.
title: المدينة المنوّرة
_master_size_doc: [2160, 3840] only when every chosen shot is vertical 4K (inventory: supports_2160x3840_master)
_look_doc: The film's shared look, applied after each shot's grade. Highlights roll off once, keeping hue, and the shoulder is anchored on the grey axis, so white reaches 100 % in every shot. highlight_desat 0..1 is how far chroma moves toward the neutral of the same lightness near 100 % (0 keeps lamps and sky fully saturated).
_music_doc: in = sample-accurate start in the track (a phrase start from work/audio/<track>.json). The music runs for the whole reel and ends at in + reel length; render.py stops before rendering if that is past the end of the track, or inside a recited/sung phrase of work/audio/<track>.json (it names the nearest phrase ends; allow_mid_phrase: true turns that into a warning). out (optional) = the planned end point: must equal in + reel length within half a frame. fade_in / fade_out in seconds; 0 = no fade at all.
_ambience_doc: clip sound under the music: src_in..src_in+dur of the clip's audio, placed at 'at' on the reel (sample-accurate). Every source must have an audio track and cover src_in+dur (checked before rendering). fade 0 = no fade.
_loudness_doc: two-pass gain only (no compression, no limiter): gain is capped so the true peak stays under the ceiling, so very dynamic material can land below the target; the shortfall is written to work/render/loudness.json (tp_limited_shortfall_lu) and warned about from 1 LU. For recitation a quieter target such as -16 is fine. max_limiter_db > 0 opts in to that much extra gain into a transparent 4x-oversampled peak limiter (default 0 = off).

shots._speed_doc: 0.7-0.85 for gentle slow motion from >=50 fps sources; keep 1.0 for 24/25/30 fps sources
shots._retime_doc: auto | frames (real frames only) | blend (even cadence for non-integer steps) | mci (motion interpolation: inspect!)
shots._frame_doc: 9:16 window centre (0-1 of the display-oriented source), zoom >= 1; optional 'end' animates a sub-pixel push/pan
shots._grade_doc: Per-shot matching in linear light: exposure (stops), temperature/tint (-1..1, ~0.1 = subtle), saturation multiplies the whole look saturation (0 = true black and white), contrast, highlights, black_crush, black_lift.
shots._hdr_doc: null = automatic. hdr_peak_nits: PQ shots only (HDR10, Dolby Vision 8.1), the content peak (MaxCLL / mastering max) that places the highlight roll-off (default: the clip's peak_nits from inventory, else 1000). hlg_display_nits: HLG shots only, the display peak Lw of the BT.2100 HLG OOTF (default 1000 = BT.2408 reference; lower Lw = lower system gamma, relatively brighter mid-tones).
shots._transition_doc: INTO this shot: cut | dissolve {dur} | dip {dur} (through black); centred on the cut point

_titles_doc: x,y = centre on the 1080x1920 canvas; drift = px of slow upward drift (0 = static); blur_from -> blur = soft focus-in. Optional per title (defaults come from the style): shadow_alpha / shadow_blur / shadow_bord = the wide soft halo, edge_alpha / edge_blur / edge_bord = the tight contact shadow (alpha 0x00 opaque .. 0xFF off; lower shadow_alpha e.g. 0x70 for a very bright background), shadow_color (RGB hex, default 100C0A). Arabic lines get a leading RLM automatically, so a line starting with a Latin word or digits still reads right-to-left. \N = line break.
_typography_doc: styles: title (Amiri Bold 340), line (IBM Plex Sans Arabic Regular 88), small (IBM Plex Sans Arabic Medium 66). Override or add a style with {"font", "size", "bold", "color", "halo": [bord, blur, alpha], "edge": [bord, blur, alpha], "shadow_color"}. Only fonts in assets/fonts are allowed: render.py stops if libass would fall back to any other font (mistyped family, emoji, missing glyph). Keep text inside x 90-910, y 250-1480 (Instagram UI). Never use \fsp letter-spacing on Arabic.
